## Change and scope

Describe the change and public behavior affected.

## Verification

Include the relevant commands/results. For behavioral fixes, include a failing-before
reproducer and the corrected result. Distinguish skipped or unmeasurable checks.

- [ ] No unversioned changes to frozen wire bytes or vectors.
- [ ] Public documentation and translations match the changed behavior.
- [ ] No private keys, customer data or internal-only dependencies included.
- [ ] Applicable contribution terms reviewed (CONTRIBUTING.md / CLA.md).
- [ ] This is not a privately reportable vulnerability.
